description.zh:
使用镜像的场景。取值范围：

- CreateEcs（默认）：创建实例。
- ChangeOS：更换系统盘/更换操作系统。
description.en:
The scenario in which the image is used. Valid values:

- CreateEcs (default): instance creation.
- ChangeOS: replacement of the system disk or operating system.

description.zh: 查询资源时的筛选条件列表。
description.en: The list of filter conditions for querying resources.

description.zh:
指定过滤条件Key，当前只支持过滤镜像ID。取值范围：
-  imageId：过滤条件为镜像ID。
-  filter：过滤条件为镜像ID。

>此参数不生效，即将下线。
description.en:
The filter condition key. Currently, only filtering by image ID is supported. Valid values:
- imageId: filters by image ID.
- filter: filters by image ID.

> This parameter is not effective and will be deprecated soon.

description.zh:
指定过滤条件Value。
>此参数不生效，即将下线。
description.en:
The filter condition value.
> This parameter is not effective and will be deprecated soon.

description.zh: 镜像所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the image. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 查询指定镜像支持的实例规格
title.en: Query instance types supported by a specified image

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-image-support-instance-types --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-o6w3gy99qf89rkga0000 --action-type CreateEcs --filter Value=m-o6w3gy99qf89rkga0000 Key=imageId --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeImageSupportInstanceTypes --region cn-hangzhou --ActionType CreateEcs --Filter.1.Value 'm-o6w3gy99qf89rkga0000' --ImageId 'm-o6w3gy99qf89rkga0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Filter.1.Key imageId
